title: touterea brandegeei
intro: Touterea brandegeei, commonly known as the Hawaiian hibiscus, is a species of flowering plant in the mallow family, Malvaceae. It is native to the Hawaiian Islands and is prized for its vibrant flowers and potential health benefits. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and rheumatism, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Touterea brandegeei include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and cardiovascular protective effects.
